title: A boolean filter argument may compare a column with an aggregation, evaluated in the outer context
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( SUM ( Sales[Amount] ), Sales[OrderDate] = MAX ( Sales[OrderDate] ) ) )

source.quote: It can contain an aggregation function that returns a scalar value.
source.supports: the page's example 'Total sales on the last selected date' has this shape: column = MAX ( column )

source.quote: CALCULATE evaluates all the explicit filter arguments in the original evaluation context, each one independently from the others.
source.supports: the filter argument, MAX included, is evaluated in the original context

derivation: MAX ( Sales[OrderDate] ) in the empty filter context is 2024-03-01 (row 7). Rows with that OrderDate: row 7 only, Amount 100.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases. The learn CALCULATETABLE page dates this allowance to the September 2021 release.
